tbesh_subentries.definition_html:
1) to ravish, become intelligent, get a mind
1a) (Niphal) to take heart, become enheartened, become intelligent
1b) (Piel) to ravish the heart, encourage, make heart beat faster
(Piel) to make cakes, bake cakes, cook bread

strongs_1890.strongs_def: (in a good sense) transport (with love), or (in a bad sense) stultify; to make cakes
strongs_1890.derivation: a primitive root; properly, to be enclosed (as if with fat); by implication (as denominative from H3824 (לֵבָב));  to unheart;  also as denominative from H3834 (לָבִיבָה) i.e.
